result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and signalized intersections in a dense commercial area. However, the crossing distance is significant across four lanes of traffic, and the lack of high-visibility painted markings or a refuge island increases exposure risk.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a long duration across four travel lanes without a median refuge.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Apply zebra or ladder style paint to the textured crossing to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow for a two-stage crossing process.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment features wide sidewalks and signalized control, but pedestrians must cross a very wide, unmarked asphalt roadway. The lack of lane markings and crosswalk paint on the main thoroughfare creates a high-exposure environment with unpredictable vehicle paths.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across multiple lanes without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings define the pedestrian path across the wide asphalt, reducing driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or island to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-density urban commercial corridor with wide sidewalks and a central median refuge that aids in multi-stage crossing. While traffic signals and speed limit markings are present, the lack of high-visibility painted crosswalks at the brick-paved intersection increases pedestrian exposure in a high-traffic environment.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The brick-paved intersection lacks high-visibility painted markings, which may lead to reduced driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction scaffolding on the right side of the street narrows the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Apply zebra or ladder-style thermoplastic markings to the brick intersection to clearly delineate the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the total crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features sidewalks and traffic control signals in a dense urban environment. Pedestrian safety is impacted by a large construction shed that narrows the walkway and creates a significant visual obstruction at the corner.

hazards.name: Construction Scaffolding
hazards.description: A large construction shed narrows the available sidewalk space and creates a tunnel effect for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the building facade

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The construction shed and its supports block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection on the left

hazards.name: Lack of High-Visibility Markings
hazards.description: The crossing area uses textured brick but lacks high-contrast painted markings to alert drivers to the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply zebra-style high-visibility paint over the brick paving to clearly define the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install temporary or permanent curb extensions to move pedestrians past the visual obstruction of the scaffolding before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install or ensure visibility of pedestrian countdown signals to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.
